annotations.text: One strip, one column per step of the APM's process flow. The document sits above the population table that records it; a step without a table of its own says where its rows live. Arrows leave the right edge of a field and enter the left edge of the field they relate to. Neighbouring steps are joined directly; a relationship that skips a step rides the bus above the documents (or below the tables), one lane each, so nothing crosses a node. The page scrolls to the right; the second artboard shows the whole strip.
The first pass, kept for reference: a side panel for the selected rule, status chips, a master-data lane and an editable step list. Judged too much for now.
